question: What fragrant materials and lamps may be offered repeatedly in the rite?
premises: Incense or aloewood may be used.
Camphor wicks and lamps are included.
These offerings are to be made many times.
inference: One may offer incense or aloewood and light many camphor-wick lamps repeatedly.
uncertainties: The compound karpura-varti-dīpāna is analyzed across fused token boundaries as given.
plain_english: One should offer incense or aloewood and light many camphor-wick lamps.
